title: Amazon Essentials x Sofia Grainge Quilted Puffer Tote, Blue Ivory Floral

comparisons.notes: Same Amazon Essentials x Sofia Grainge Quilted Puffer Tote Bag with Zip, One Size; listing photo matches the Blue Ivory Delicate Floral print in Woot's image. Peer reseller, plus $6.49 shipping.

writeup: This Amazon Essentials x Sofia Grainge quilted puffer tote comes in the Blue Ivory Delicate Floral print, with a zip top, a large front zip pocket and five interior pockets. The same bag in this print is listed at $40 on Poshmark, so Woot's $8.99 Sellout price is a steep markdown, limited to 10 per customer.
